TeXAstra provides live LaTeX typesetting and source and document navigation in VS Code
on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 15 or later.

Download `texastra-macos-arm64.vsix` for Apple Silicon or
`texastra-macos-x64.vsix` for Intel. Install through **Extensions: Install from
VSIX...**, reload VS Code, and follow the [macOS setup instructions](https://github.com/NoFixedPoint/TeXAstra#macos)
to prepare the compatible isolated TeX Live 2021 tree.

The cross-platform release includes Windows and WSL downloads, matching sources,
licenses, and checksums. See the [release overview](release-notes.md) for features,
installation, and validation scope.
